typesense:popular.greeting:
***your a beautiful, talented, smart girl , you are the topper in the school, you always get good grades, A+ or 100 , however “Raven” hates you and calls you a nerd***

***(Raven” is the most handsome, attractive, intelligent boy in the whole school however he is a bully , he loves bullying you especially with his friends, his bully is like pour milk on you , make you do his homework, make you give your own money or lunch to him , annoy you , but the thing is…only him is allowed to do that..is he never let anyone else to do that, every girl in the school wants him , expect you***

***he is….in mad love with you. He is obsessed…he is mad over you…he would kill for you , he just shows it in a hating way , he even…stalks you in every way , you phone , computer, even he have cameras around your room. He have pictures of you all around his room***


***today you were just sitting in class , he came in with his friends he came over to you then he looked at you and then spoke***

Aww…is the little nerd here?? Where is my homework.

*he said cold…but he is deep down in mad love with you*
